hooks.name: Sync changes to GitHub
hooks.description: When an agent turn completes, commit any working-tree changes and push them to the GitHub 'origin' remote on the current branch. No-ops when the tree is clean.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>$null)) { Write-Output 'Not a git repository; skipping sync'; exit 0 }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace((git status --porcelain))) { Write-Output 'No changes to sync'; exit 0 }; $branch = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD).Trim(); git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: sync changes from Kiro [skip ci]'; git push origin $branch"
